raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

`/v1/completions` with `echo=true` and `truncate_prompt_tokens` echoes the full, untruncated prompt for token-ID prompts, although the engine only sees the truncated tokens. The renderer detokenizes the prompt before `apply_post_tokenization` truncates it; this PR detokenizes after truncation instead, restoring the behavior from before the renderer refactor.

## Claims

- For token-ID prompts, the echoed `text` is now the decode of the tokens that reach the engine, so it agrees with `usage.prompt_tokens`, `logprobs.tokens` and `logprobs.text_offset`.
- Fixed for both truncation sides, and for streaming and non-streaming responses (both read `RequestOutput.prompt`).
- No change for text prompts, chat `echo`, or `/detokenize`.

## Validation

Real server on `a9fe30e9f6` (Qwen3-0.6B, RTX 4090, `--enforce-eager`), before and after the fix. Request: token IDs of `"one two three four five six seven eight"` (8 tokens) with `echo=true, max_tokens=1, logprobs=0, truncate_prompt_tokens=4`. `usage.prompt_tokens` is 4 in every case.

| `truncation_side` | Echoed `text` before | Echoed `text` after | `text_offset` indexes `text` correctly (before → after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| unset (tokenizer default, left) | `one two three four five six seven eight com` | ` five six seven eight com` | no (`text[0:5] == "one t"` for token `" five"`) → yes |
| `left` | `one two three four five six seven eight com` | ` five six seven eight com` | no → yes |
| `right` | `one two three four five six seven eight five` | `one two three four five` | yes, but `text` contains 4 prompt tokens the model never saw → yes |

Tests:

- New `tests/renderers/test_completions.py::TestRenderPrompt::test_detokenization_matches_truncated_tokens` covers the sync and async paths with left and right truncation. It fails on `main` (the echoed prompt contains all 10 tokens) and passes with the fix.
- `pytest tests/renderers`: 632 passed. The 3 failures in `test_hf.py` need gated Hugging Face repos (`meta-llama/Llama-Guard-3-1B`, `fixie-ai/ultravox-v0_5-llama-3_2-1b`, `google/paligemma-3b-mix-224`) that my machine has no access to.
- `pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/completion/test_completion.py -k "echo or truncation or single_completion or prompt_logprobs or batch_completions"`: 9 passed.
- `pre-commit run --files <changed files>`: all hooks pass, including mypy.

<details>
<summary>Reproduction script</summary>

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --port 8011 --max-model-len 2048 --enforce-eager
python repro.py http://127.0.0.1:8011
```

```python
import sys

import requests

BASE = sys.argv[1]
model = requests.get(f"{BASE}/v1/models").json()["data"][0]["id"]
ids = requests.post(
    f"{BASE}/tokenize",
    json={"model": model, "prompt": "one two three four five six seven eight",
          "add_special_tokens": False},
).json()["tokens"]

for side in (None, "left", "right"):
    body = {"model": model, "prompt": ids, "echo": True, "max_tokens": 1,
            "temperature": 0, "logprobs": 0, "truncate_prompt_tokens": 4}
    if side:
        body["truncation_side"] = side
    choice = requests.post(f"{BASE}/v1/completions", json=body).json()["choices"][0]
    lp = choice["logprobs"]
    spans = [choice["text"][o:o + len(t)] for o, t in zip(lp["text_offset"], lp["tokens"])]
    print(side, repr(choice["text"]), "offsets consistent:", spans == lp["tokens"])
```

</details>

## Details

Root cause: in `BaseRenderer._tokenize_singleton_prompt` and its async twin, `needs_detokenization` decoded `prompt_token_ids` before `TokenizeParams.apply_post_tokenization` applied `truncate_prompt_tokens`, so `prompt` described the original token list while `prompt_token_ids` was truncated. `needs_detokenization` is only set for completions/chat `echo` (without `return_token_ids`) and `/detokenize`. Before the renderer refactor, `OpenAIServing._normalize_prompt_tokens_to_input` truncated first and decoded the truncated IDs (see `v0.10.1`).

Limitation: text prompts keep echoing the original string, as they did in `v0.10.1` (the Rust frontend also echoes the request prompt). Aligning that would need the renderer to know whether tokenizer-side truncation actually dropped tokens; I left it out to keep this fix small, and can follow up if maintainers want it.

Not a duplicate: I found no issue or PR for this (searched "echo truncate", "detokenize prompt", "truncate_prompt_tokens", "truncation_side", "echo text_offset"). #61363 and #61524 change which special tokens truncation keeps, not when the echoed text is decoded.

AI assistance was used to find this bug, write the fix and the test, and run the validation shown above.

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        ("truncation_side", "expected"),
+        [("left", [106, 107, 108, 109]), ("right", [100, 101, 102, 103])],
+    )
+    def test_detokenization_matches_truncated_tokens(self, truncation_side, expected):
+        """Echoed prompt text must match the truncated tokens sent to the engine."""
+        renderer = _build_renderer(MockModelConfig())
+        params = TokenizeParams(
+            max_total_tokens=100,
+            truncate_prompt_tokens=4,
+            truncation_side=truncation_side,
+            needs_detokenization=True,
+        )
+
+        def render():
+            return renderer.render_prompts(
+                _preprocess_prompt(renderer.model_config, list(range(100, 110)))
+            )
+
+        results = renderer.tokenize_prompts(render(), params)
+        async_results = asyncio.run(renderer.tokenize_prompts_async(render(), params))
+
+        for result in (*results, *async_results):
+            assert result["prompt_token_ids"] == expected
+            assert result["prompt"] == str(expected)
+
     def test_explicit_side_tokenizer_unbounded(self):
         renderer = _build_renderer(MockModelConfig())

@@ -687,13 +687,17 @@ def _tokenize_singleton_prompt(

             prompt = self._apply_prompt_char_offset(prompt, prompt_char_offset)
 
+        prompt = params.apply_post_tokenization(self.tokenizer, prompt)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+
+        # Detokenize after truncation so the text matches the tokens sent
+        # to the engine.
